convergence.description: Gate config-done on the MPLS L3VPN converging — ONE suite for BOTH platform flavors (test-suites v2, contract delta 17): each test carries a device-keyed case, so the same file PUTs onto examples/mpls-l3vpn.yml (vyos) and examples/mpls-l3vpn.iol.yml (iol). Show-based (no live ping): asserts the programmed state — OSPF adjacency, LDP session (VyOS via vtysh JSON + compare; IOL via the Twinlab TextFSM template + compare), VPNv4 sessions Established toward every remote PE (rendered peer addresses), and a label-switched VRF route toward each remote customer site (VRF loopbacks rendered from the lab's facts — nothing hardcoded). TE tunnels and IP SLA are IOL-only (the mpls_te/ip_sla built-ins ship ios templates only), so those tests simply skip on the VyOS lab.

ospf_full.description: Every node has a Full OSPF adjacency (the area-0 core is up).

ldp_operational.description: Every node has an operational LDP session (MPLS transport LSPs up).

vpnv4_established.description: pe1's VPNv4 iBGP sessions to every other PE are Established with routes received — peer addresses rendered from the lab's facts.

vyos.command: vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 vpn summary json"

iol.command: show ip bgp vpnv4 all summary

fib_reach_pe1_to_pe4.description: pe1's VRF FIB label-switches toward pe4's customer site (VPNv4 imported + LSP programmed) — the customer loopback rendered from the facts, not hardcoded.

vyos.command: vtysh -c "show ip route vrf vpn_a {{ nodes.pe4.vrfs.vpn_a.loopback_address.ipv4 | address }}"

iol.command: show ip cef vrf vpn_a {{ nodes.pe4.vrfs.vpn_a.loopback_address.ipv4 | address }} detail

fib_reach_pe4_to_pe1.description: pe4's VRF FIB label-switches toward pe1's customer site (reverse path).

vyos.command: vtysh -c "show ip route vrf vpn_a {{ nodes.pe1.vrfs.vpn_a.loopback_address.ipv4 | address }}"

iol.command: show ip cef vrf vpn_a {{ nodes.pe1.vrfs.vpn_a.loopback_address.ipv4 | address }} detail

te_tunnels_up.description: Each PE has at least one MPLS-TE head-end tunnel signalled up/up (RSVP-TE mesh from the mpls_te built-in; ios-only, so this skips on the VyOS lab).

ip_sla_ok.description: Each PE's IP SLA ICMP-echo probes into the L3VPN return OK (the ip_sla built-in; ios-only, so this skips on the VyOS lab).

reachability.description: On-demand cross-VPN traffic proof: ping pe4's customer loopback from inside pe1's VRF (and back). Live traffic, so a runtime suite, not a config-time gate. The IOL case is interactive — IOS truncates timed commands on a one-shot exec channel, so it rides the persistent netmiko CLI channel (delta 17).
